headline: WEEK 4: ONLYFANTS GOES FULL PORN-STAR, QAMON GETS RAILED BY THE BADDIES
subhead: 174 points, a 33-point ass-whooping, and Nick leaving 37 points on the bench in a one-point win — Week 4 was unhinged.
matchOfTheWeek: Nut Olave Your Face beat Little Peckers by 1.22 points while leaving 37.42 on his bench — Carson Wentz (23.2) and Marvin Mims (20.5) watched from the pine while Nick somehow still squeaked it out. Little Peckers got 33.4 from Pickens, 27.5 from Hampton, and 27.3 from Mahomes and STILL lost. That's not a loss, that's a war crime against probability.
powerRankingsShakeup: T swift's Baddies and OnlyFants kicked the door in and announced themselves as actual contenders, while QAmon and Rub My Chubb are speedrunning the toilet bowl. Browning Out scored 168 and lost — somewhere a hole opened in the earth.
mainRecap:
Let's start with the carnage. T swift's Baddies dropped 171.78 on QAmon and Kyle is sitting there watching Woody Marks put up 27.90 ON HIS BENCH. Twenty-eight points. On the bench. While starting whoever the hell he started instead. Dead Rat couldn't save you, King Unc couldn't save you, and ShAmon-Ra apparently took the week off. That's a 33.90-point loss with a side of self-inflicted gunshot wound.

OnlyFants put up the high score of the week (174.62) behind a 33.5 spot from Jeanty, but Browning Out scored 168.48 AND LOST. Patrick, you got Puka Nacua to drop a 36-burger and it bought you exactly nothing. Welcome to dynasty, where 168 points gets you a participation ribbon and a kick in the dick.

Christian McCalfinjury handled Rub My Chubb by 25 because Dak went nuclear (30.96), and Big D's only hero was Kenneth Gainwell of all people putting up 31.4. When Kenneth fucking Gainwell is your league-winner you need to stare at the ceiling and reflect. Hat tip though — 97.1% lineup efficiency in a loss is the most Rub My Chubb thing ever: optimized all the way to last place in scoring.

Egbukkake squeaked past The Good Ladds by 6, but Szara left Romeo Doubs and his 29.80 points rotting on the bench. Erick None indeed. The Good Ladds got dragged down by Jaydon 3, Jayden 2, and whoever the hell Jayden 1 is — the entire Jayden cinematic universe collapsed in unison.

Stroud Boys quietly handled McBride 146-139 despite Josh Jacobs dropping 31.7 for the Hock. And Mustard cooked for 28.1 in Nick's bench-clown one-point miracle. Everyone in this league is bad at football. Some are just better at hiding it.
